_comment: Reference/upstream projects. Source is cloned here for study only and is NOT part of the runtime. `reuse` records how Radar uses each project; scripts/update_notices.py regenerates THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from this file and from the LICENSE file at the pinned commit.

projects.name: CondenseIt
adapted: Exponential preference time decay with explicit/implicit event weights (radar/services/feedback.py)
og:image / twitter:image fallback order for article thumbnails (radar/extraction/metadata.py, reimplemented on lxml)

projects.name: Horizon
adapted: Tracking query-parameter stripping for URL identity keys (radar/extraction/canonical_url.py)
OSS Insight trends API usage and row field mapping (radar/collectors/github.py)
old.reddit.com fallback for unauthenticated Reddit access and t.me/s public channel preview parsing (radar/collectors/reddit.py, radar/collectors/telegram.py)

projects.name: News Llama
adapted: Auditable candidate-to-trial-to-promotion source lifecycle and quality gating (radar/discovery/service.py)

projects.name: Cruxwire
adapted: Anchor-style time-windowed story clustering above a cosine threshold (radar/clustering/service.py)
Coverage-aware explainable score components and source diversity (radar/ranking/scorer.py)
Server-side source affinity learned from opens, saves, likes, dislikes and dismissals (radar/services/feedback.py)

projects.name: YourRSS
projects.license: README states MIT, but the commit has no LICENSE file

excluded.name: InReader
